At a glance

A Dutch charger with a 5 m cable, MID meter, 4G and RFID: for building garages and company car parks.

  • Tethered 5 m Type 2 cable: park and plug in.
  • Up to 22 kW on a 3 × 32 A line. Most cars take at most 11 kW on AC, and the charger can be set lower.
  • Built-in MID-certified meter records energy for the monthly statement.
  • 4G: the charger stays online without Wi-Fi wherever there is mobile signal.
  • RFID reader: charging starts with your card, handy in a shared garage.
  • Ethernet and 4G, OCPP 1.6.

In the box and installation

In the box

Charger with 5 m cable, wall bracket, manual in Serbian.

What installation needs

For 11 kW you need a three-phase 3 × 16 A line; for 22 kW, 3 × 32 A. Basic installation next to your panel (up to 2 m of cable, RCD and breaker) starts at RSD 24,000. No separate MID meter needed.
